name: Cabinet
description: A lightweight self-hosted file cabinet and document manager.
summary: Cabinet v0.5.0 (released 2026-07-04, 238 commits since v0.4.0) is the largest release to date, introducing 'Connect Knowledge' for read-only cloud drive integration (Google Drive, iCloud, OneDrive/SharePoint, Dropbox), a significantly expanded Integrations Hub with 52 connectors (Slack, Google, Microsoft 365, Snowflake, LinkedIn, Discord, Telegram), and per-room agent Channels. Other major additions include a Telegram remote-control gateway, in-app browser, enhanced editor (Mermaid, LaTeX), and improved auth with PBKDF2 password hashing and login rate-limiting. See release notes at https://github.com/hilash/cabinet.

answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — v0.5.0 released 2026-07-04 with 238 commits and multiple contributors
answers.Does it support user authentication?: Yes — PBKDF2 password hashing with per-install salt, login rate-limiting, and KB_PASSWORD gate

breaking_excerpts: Clean-path routing: the app now serves clean URLs instead of hash routes across web and Electron; old hash links are parsed via a marker-scan fallback but the canonical form is path-based.
Channels on-disk rename: the internal team-chat directory moved from '.slack' to '.channels', scoped per room.

alternatives.name: Paperless-ngx
alternatives.review: Paperless-ngx offers far more powerful document management with OCR and tagging but is significantly heavier and more complex to self-host than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Teedy
alternatives.review: Teedy provides a more feature-rich document management system with workflows and ACLs, but comes with greater resource overhead compared to Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Filestash
alternatives.review: Filestash is similarly lightweight and supports multiple storage backends, but focuses on file browsing rather than document management features like tagging or OCR.

alternatives.name: Docspell
alternatives.review: Docspell offers robust document organization with OCR and metadata extraction, but requires a more involved setup with multiple services compared to Cabinet's simplicity.

alternatives.name: Nextcloud
alternatives.review: Nextcloud is a comprehensive self-hosted platform covering files, documents, and collaboration, but is far heavier and more complex than Cabinet's focused lightweight approach.
